result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign or SignWell**\. They're easier to use and generally less expensive than enterprise-focused platforms like DocuSign, while providing the core features most small businesses need.

However, the best choice depends on how many documents you send, how many employees need access, and whether you need contracts, proposals, or just signatures.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best overall for simplicity)

- Easy to send, sign, and track documents.
- Reusable templates and signing workflows.
- Good for client agreements and service contracts.
- Paid plans start around US\$15/month.

Best if you want something professional that simply works.

[Dropbox Sign website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![SignWell Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Jr7ERfTZr0cqqbqtQojc1WgFegKKLiPrJurgeTes_GrO9qxMF5YkVG9gVLeB9qvt7YBC6Q6pkJBI9N_c51xLlztOk6hKzac7E4lFA8rd9eBpetTe_xy1klt7wGh6uRBKJslwwXSnJXsHHrXPP9HSa1AdMDl53XAX_hATAxwkkaXeQ7t2kL5k6NsdkQn3lUlj?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. SignWell**

(Best budget option)

- Very straightforward interface.
- Reusable document templates.
- Audit trails and reminders.
- Free plan for occasional signing; paid plans offer more capacity.

Best for freelancers and small businesses watching expenses.

[SignWell website](https://www.signwell.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. DocuSign**

- Widely recognized by customers.
- Extensive integrations.
- Strong document tracking and workflow features.
- Entry plans around US\$10–15/month, with sending limits.

Best if you want a well-established platform that can grow with your business.

[DocuSign website](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

- Creates proposals, quotes, and contracts.
- Includes electronic signatures.
- Supports document templates and sales workflows.
- Paid plans start around US\$19/user/month with annual billing.

Best if you regularly send customer proposals and sales agreements.

[PandaDoc website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Zoho Sign - Apps Documentation](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SUcET-87d95vVganDQlyhWq-yiws-wQ_od0uceT-oSgYYMR06035CJR-_lwRhqFA2Wk42Qb4rsaFUnfX59ev935AI6sAEgF3T2dA_v2J3qmxQzTtV0tKWD6AvgqazINgryECCXcm3UqYqzrO6XPMiLUxQFIqLMyy4JMl92yn0HiutGHZpNfO5gb5ETOux07n?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Sign**

- Affordable options for small teams.
- Document templates and automated signing.
- Integrates with Zoho CRM and other Zoho products.
- Free plan available; paid plans start around US\$10/user/month.

Best if you already use Zoho for your business.

[Zoho Sign website](https://www.zoho.com/sign/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**6\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

- Excellent PDF functionality.
- Combines PDF editing and electronic signing.
- Useful for businesses working with lots of PDF contracts.

Best if your business already uses Adobe Acrobat.

[Adobe Acrobat Sign website](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/sign.html)

*Pricing is indicative, primarily in US dollars, and can vary by billing frequency, country, and plan. Check current sending limits before subscribing.* These options and their relative strengths are consistent with recent 2026 comparisons. ## My recommendation for a Canadian small business

Since you're operating in Canada, I'd pay attention to more than just price\:

- Whether the platform supports Canadian electronic-signature requirements.
- Whether it provides a downloadable audit trail and signing certificate.
- Whether documents are securely stored.
- Whether Canadian data residency is important to your business.
- Whether the subscription limits how many documents you can send.

If Canadian data hosting is a priority, also investigate eZsign\. It's a Canadian-focused alternative with local hosting. The best e-signature software in 2026
search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
